title: Demand-Driven Routing Space for Lattice-Surgery Compilation
summary: Lattice-surgery compilation places logical qubits on a grid of surface-code tiles and routes their interactions. Sparse static layouts limit routing contention but reserve space that often remains idle. Reducing this reservation requires balancing area savings against additional gate serialization and qubit movement. In this paper, we present a co-designed dynamic architecture and compiler that allocates routing space according to circuit demand.
